recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for this seed unless a future work group decision separately addresses the unbound legacy payee resource-type terminology artifacts.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FM change request from STU3 asking to remove Claim.payee.resource because identifier/reference datatype handling now covers the resource identification use case; Jira related artifacts list Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit.
initial_application: Historical commit afb5ec66f68641293bb7950b6e0eeb118fa1444a explicitly lists FHIR-17918 and removes Claim.payee.resource plus its ClaimPayeeResourceType binding from the Claim spreadsheet. Adjacent EOB history in 89bb47c31d84c7cc3fb753e5408806226f62d395 removes ExplanationOfBenefit.payee.resource and its PayeeResourceType binding.
additional_context: Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Current Claim.payee and ExplanationOfBenefit.payee contain payee.type and payee.party only, with payee.party typed as Reference to the permitted payee resource types. Reference.type and Reference.identifier provide the datatype-level target type and logical identifier support cited by the Jira. FHIR-12919 is prior background that introduced the older payee.resource element after payee.resourceType conflicted with JSON serialization.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative StructureDefinition sources already reflect the published decision, and broader legacy payee resource-type terminology artifacts are unbound historical terminology that should not be removed under FHIR-17918 without a separate terminology decision.

related_jiras.note: Prior published issue renamed payee.resourceType to payee.resource and aligned Claim/EOB binding strength; it explains the element that FHIR-17918 later removed.
